response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, CAST(analysis_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts

assumptions.assumption: A trader with no recorded tradekind does not belong to a trader type and is excluded from the counts and denominator.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a missing tradekind as its own group.
